## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run verify` passes (format, types, tests, build)
- [ ] New or changed behavior has a test; a fixed bug has a test that failed before
- [ ] Interface text is in `web/src/i18n/en.ts` **and** `pt-BR.ts`
- [ ] No personal data in the diff (workspace files, CVs, PDFs/DOCXs, real names or e-mails)
- [ ] No network calls, telemetry or AI API calls made by the app on its own (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
